findings.title: Output section lists `trigger`, which the Design's field list does not include
findings.detail: output_section derives the optional finding fields from reviewer_schema, so it lists `detail`, `trigger`, `files` and `lines`. The Design names only `detail`, `files` and `lines`. The 'As shipped' section records this deviation, and it follows the spec's own rule that the section is read from the enforced schema.
findings.suggested_fix: No code change. Keep the 'As shipped' note, or add `trigger` to the Design's list in the spec so the two agree.
findings.acceptance: The spec Design and the generated `## Output` text name the same optional fields.

findings.title: The review-context test checks diff and test_files in two separate places
findings.detail: test_build_request_declared_reviewer checks that the diff content reaches req.prompt. It checks test_files only through a separate build_context(review=True) call, and only because the test template has no {{test_files}} placeholder. So the review=is_reviewer(...) wiring for test_files is covered only indirectly. The diff check does exercise that wiring.
findings.suggested_fix: In tests/test_agentic_persona_run_settings.py, add {{test_files}} to TEMPLATE (it is in the reviewer role's placeholders) and assert 'tests/test_a.py' in req.prompt inside test_build_request_declared_reviewer.
findings.acceptance: test_build_request_declared_reviewer asserts that the test file path appears in the built request's prompt.

ac_assessment.evidence: persona_registry.check_declared_keys validates model (MODEL_ALIASES/MODEL_RE), effort (EFFORTS) and max_budget_usd (_is_num, >0, bool refused), importing profiles lazily. validate_persona_doc refuses the keys in a builtin with 'allowed only in a user or project definition'. Tests: test_settings_keys_valid (all three roles), test_settings_keys_invalid (each bad value, asserts the origin file and the key), test_declared_keys_refused_in_a_builtin_definition.

check_declared_keys refuses required/when on implementer/triager ('only allowed for role reviewer'). It checks that required is a bool and that when is a mapping with only paths/labels, each a non-empty list of non-empty strings. declared_values defaults to required True and when {}. Tests: test_routing_keys_valid_for_reviewer, test_routing_keys_reviewer_only_bad_shapes (null, list, scalar, unknown key, empty list, non-string item, empty string), test_routing_keys_reviewer_only, and test_declared_mapping_defaults for the defaults.

persona_defs._read_file and persona_registry.validate_persona_doc both call PR.check_declared_keys. test_multi_fault_file_reports_every_problem_in_both_validators checks that the same messages come back from validate_persona_defs and from load_registry entry errors. The CLI test test_validate_and_list_agree_on_new_key_problems checks that validate, list and show agree.

personas.is_reviewer returns early for builtins and when no root is given; otherwise it checks the registry role. test_is_reviewer covers a declared reviewer, implementer and triager, the no-root case, a project that does not declare the persona, and every builtin with and without a root.

build_request resolves the persona with get_persona(persona, project_cfg['_root'], user_dir) and uses declared_settings for non-builtins. declared_settings layers DECLARED_DEFAULTS < the role-default profile entry < the definition < personas.<name>, and forces read_only/dontAsk for read-only roles. test_build_request_declared_reviewer_layering covers 6 layer combinations. test_build_request_declared_reviewer covers read_only/dontAsk overriding a profile entry with read_only false and bypassPermissions, an empty allowlist, and json_schema == reviewer_schema. The triager test and test_build_request_declared_implementer_writable (acceptEdits plus allowlist) cover the other roles.

build_context is called with review=is_reviewer(...). test_build_request_declared_reviewer checks that the diff content ('src/a.py', "print('hi')") is in the prompt, that a worktree .nw/personas copy (different template, model and categories) has no effect, and that a reviewer declared only in the worktree is unknown. test_files is checked through build_context.

personas.output_section builds the block from p.schema. build_prompt places it between the template and the invariant only when declared is set and role is reviewer. test_output_section checks the placement and the category list including `other`. test_builtin_prompts_unchanged checks that every builtin prompt equals render(template)+'

'+render(invariant)+'
'.

cli_personas._declared_fields is added to _summary (list --json) and to the show output, both human and JSON. test_show_and_list_json_carry_declared_fields_and_omit_them_for_builtins checks settings, required, when and sha for a declared reviewer, leaves out required/when for an implementer, and finds none of these fields for builtins or broken entries.

The diff does not touch queue.py, profiles.py or divergence.py. The builtin Persona has declared=None, so PERSONAS is unchanged. test_inert checks the builtin tables and that resolve_profile still raises for a declared reviewer in reviewers:.

docs/product/capabilities/agentic.md has a new 'Declared personas' subsection with the security_reviewer example, the role table, the new keys and their layering, nw personas list|show|validate, and a bold statement that the queue does not run declared personas yet.
